Episode 246: The Battle for the Mitra Desert (20)
"Brothers!"
The Battle Kings started to protect Owl just by hearing that. Their weapons fended off the Red Plutonian’s relentless thunder cannons.
Meanwhile, Jin checked the direction where Shimat and Ziffle's forces appeared.
'It seems that Lady Elona has appeared in person again.'
A fleet of twenty ships, including Kozec, was also visible. The White Night, Demon Unit, and Phantom Unit were powerful and positioned themselves.
'I expected it, but as I thought... Ziffle and the Red Plutonian never attack each other. That's why they brought the fleet.'

There was no need to fight any longer since the liberation device had been thrown into the passage of Laprarosa. If Elona joined the battle, the tide would turn very quickly. It was best to retreat as quickly as possible while taking care of the injured Owl.
'I'll have to escape while Runkandel covers me.'
Luna and Vanessa had already come to the same conclusion and were approaching Jin.
However, Jin was not in a situation to welcome them. Shimat was looking at Jin with cold, hard eyes.
"It seems like some plan has succeeded, Jin Runkandel. Seeing you hurry to escape."
"Yeah, I've been caught."
"You think I'll just let it go?"
Swoosh!
The red blade of Tetalon narrowly passed in front of Jin's eyes. Sigmund nearly grazed him, but the attack trajectory was altered due to the assisting energy waves of the fortress.
'It's not easy to get used to close combat with Shimat.'
All angles are assisted by the fortress.
That was the most annoying part when fighting Shimat. The energy waves assisting Shimat had a density that was not easy to push back, even for Jin.
As a result, the closer he got, the more freedom Shimat had in movement, while Jin was restricted.
"That would be good."

"You guys probably threw some device capable of summoning Laprarosa into the passage. But it seems the Blue Wind Emperor didn't explain that to you. In the error state of subspace, such precise machinery can't withstand it."
Then, the best strategy would be to suppress with overwhelming strength, but there was no person in this world who could surpass Shimat.
'Even the strongest fortress in the air, known as Kri, has not appeared in the great desert yet. If I fail to safely liberate all the brothers this time, there is no future.'
At the moment when Jin and Shimat's swords crossed again, Luna and Vanessa broke through the Red Plutonian energy wave and intruded.
The Battle Kings, even this time, matched their steps without waiting for Jin's command, beginning to clear a path to the rear, centering around Owl and including the rest of their comrades.
"You three alone, against our pursuit..."
[Keeyahh!]
[Die, die!]
Suddenly, the voices of the trio of demons were heard, causing Shimat's face to contort. On the other hand, Jin brightened up and quickly requested a deal from Masalrun.
"Masalrun, 5 minutes of touching Shuri. How about it?"
[Contract complete. Masalrun curses you, Shimat.]
Even if Shimat and the air fortress's synergy were close to ultimate, the trio of demons were literally invincible in the Great Desert.
Now they were not as frail as before, so even Shimat couldn't completely ignore them.
In some ways, it was much more troublesome than the addition of Luna and Vanessa. Although they lacked the same destructive power, these demons were impossible to counter in the first place.
No matter how strong the Divine Sword contained in Tetalon was, it couldn't cut through the demons. Led by Masalrun, the demons quickly increased the distance between Shimat and Jin.
Then, Jin, quietly watching them, made another trade request.
"Add another 5 minutes with Shuri, but in exchange, have Sribi and Karmashu keep an eye on Ziffle."
[Fine, but Sribi and Karmashu's consent is also needed.]
[If Masalrun agrees, then why not.]
[Always depressed and sulky, guess we should fulfill the request of that guy. But Jin Runkandel, don't we get anything?]
"Touch Shuri if you need."
[Masalrun might not like that. Hmm! Alright, how about this? After the Battle for the Mitra Desert, can you look after our kids for a while?]
By 'our kids,' they obviously meant Kinzelo.
"I didn't expect such a request, quite surprising."
[But the guy who summoned us is there. Orgal, well... he is somewhat an important figure in the history of the abyss/underworld.]
"Alright, I promise."
Jin nodded without hesitation.
The condition he demanded was very vague. Even if he didn't attack Kinzelo for just one day after the desert battle, it could be considered as fulfilling the promise.
[Hehe, the kids will be happy. Then, we're off to push back those Ziffle guys. No second words later!]
Sribi and Karmashu, unaware of Jin's cunning intentions, chuckled and moved towards Elona.
"They're really fools, aren't they, youngest?"

"Kinzelo has always had the advantage of being easy to manipulate. The rest are all disadvantages, which is the problem. So, we need to protect the one advantage we have. Otherwise, I'll kill them all."
"For a moment, I thought the head of the family was speaking, young master."
The three of them smirked and glared at Shimat.
Shimat was unable to close the distance with Jin and his group again due to Masalrun's curse. Although he fired energy waves with his Divine Thunder Sword, that alone couldn't bind the three.

Instead, the power of the air fortress, which Shimat had been using for close combat, was now returning to the main cannon. The main cannon relentlessly spewed fire over the heads of the retreating allies.
Had Teto and Garmund not appeared suddenly, the allies would have suffered significant damage at this point.

The Battle Kings were fending off the thunder cannons without sparing themselves. The maximum firepower would be overwhelming even for them, but the air fortress was regulating the power of the main cannon to within 50%.
Firing the main cannon at full power would inevitably harm Ziffle’s party as well, and more importantly, Jin, Luna, and Vanessa posed a problem.
Conversely, they could close the distance with Shimat first and launch an offensive. If the power needed to support close combat is insufficient, even Shimat could not avoid serious injury.
For the Red Plutonian, this was a point of frustration and irritation.
If not for the demons, they could dominate in every aspect, but such a grip on their ankle was unprecedented.
Of course, Jin and his comrades were not without their worries either.
"...Young master, we don't know when the demons might suddenly turn on us. We need to finish the liberation process before they change sides."
If the demons turn against them, the Barmel Alliance would inevitably shed a lot of blood. Not just the injured, but there would be casualties as well.
"We will make it happen."
Jin dodged the energy waves of the Divine Thunder Sword and focused on Ziffle’s side.
Sribi and Karmashu were hovering around Elona like persistent mosquitoes. Unlike Shimat, she was allowing quite a few solid hits, but there was no damage.
Elona was also watching Jin. If she began to stir up the battlefield in earnest, in addition to the Battle Kings, at least two or more superhumans would have to form a defensive line.
At present, this was the most burdensome task. Sribi and Karmashu couldn't stop Elona as effectively as Masalrun.
In fact, Elona was approaching the battlefield faster than Jin had expected.
After all, for a magician of her caliber, distance wasn't that important a factor. If they could already visually identify each other, it meant they could attack at any time.
Elona's gaze shifted to the retreating comrades. Jin and his group tensed up, heightening their senses.
Amidst this, Shimat occasionally escaped Masalrun's curse and thrust Tetalon. When Luna and Vanessa parried his sword, Jin thrust in Sigmund.
Though they never landed a solid hit on each other, the Barmel Alliance felt the greater burden.
'But why hasn't Lady Elona attacked yet?'
Elona had not swung her staff at the Barmel Alliance since her appearance.
Kozec and the ships didn't fire their main cannons either, and the troops were just waiting for Elona's command.
Jin wasn't the only one puzzled by this fact.
'...What's the reason Lady Elona isn't giving orders? Is there some danger in the Great Desert we don't know about?'
'It can't be because of the demons; Lady Elona hasn't taken any hits. Could it be the reason the White Night leader was worried about...!'
White Night Leader Satrin.

She had shared with her close associates that the binding power of the Holy Crown wasn't complete. If Elona were to return to her senses in a real emergency, the White Night would have to disobey her commands.
'If this is due to weakened binding, damn... Kadun should have come with us.'
For the members of the White Night, the situation was ambiguous.
It wasn't urgent enough to go against Elona's will, and more importantly, there was no certainty that the Holy Crown was the issue.
"Lady Elona, you need to give orders..."
Unable to hold back, a Ghost Corps member approached Elona. On the surface, Elona seemed to have no problems.
"Keep waiting."
"Excuse me?"
"It seems you're not as well trained as the Phantom Unit. How could someone who questions a superior's command ever become part of Ziffle’s elite special forces?"
Elona spoke with an expressionless face. Just as she said, the Phantom Unit waited for Elona without showing impatience, as did the biological golems of the Demon Unit.
"I apologize."
"You might unconsciously perceive me just as a high-ranking biological weapon. I'll make sure to hold the White Night leader accountable when we return."
The White Night member had no choice but to bow deeply and retreat.
And Elona was thinking.

'The being that shot sword energy across dimensions at me could easily kill everyone gathered here. Moreover, the Barmel Alliance is retreating. Even if I join the battle, annihilating them is impossible, so it's a better choice to avoid unnecessary variables and loss of troops. Besides...'
Elona met Jin's eyes again.
'...Jin Runkandel, for some reason, I really don't want to kill him myself. I'm not sure if Kelliac Ziffle will accept such an excuse.'
